cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.

mechanism: A coaches its former debating pupil to name a desired election winner before learning A choice or the result.
confusable: Not merely withholding news: A wants B uncontaminated preference and prevents pupil pleasing the teacher by copying A answer.
comparison: Election allegiance versus preference about A job move.
